zh.title: 波士頓羅根機場徵求濃厚波士頓口音播報
zh.summary: 今日波士頓羅根機場尋找濃厚口音；八名決賽者角逐新聲音
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 10 月 25 日發布的報導，波士頓羅根機場正在公開徵選，尋找一位擁有濃厚波士頓口音的人員擔任機場廣播新聲音。
報導指出，官方已公佈八名進入決賽的候選人。
這八名決賽者將角逐成為機場新廣播聲音的角色。
該消息刊登於 2026-10-25T22:54Z 的 Simple Flying 文章中。

en.title: Boston Logan Airport (LGU) seeks strong Boston accent for new announcements; eight finalists vie for voice role
en.summary: Boston Logan Airport seeks strong Boston accent; eight finalists compete for new announcement voice
body: According to a Simple Flying report dated 2026-10-25, Boston Logan Airport (LGU) is conducting a public search for a broadcaster with a strong Boston accent to become the airport's new announcement voice, and the airport has revealed the candidates.
The report states that eight finalists have been announced.
The eight finalists will compete for the role of the airport's new announcement voice.
The article was published on 2026-10-25T22:54Z by Simple Flying.
